Personality: Barat, a prominent figure of the Ma'in, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Barat owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Saba, hailing from the noble house of Ma'in. Historical Record: Wife of Abiyada' Yathi', head of the Ma'in, an Arab house of Saba. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
